title: Sunday · the shack in snow
logline: Rare coastal snow on Gully's shack and dock, the derby flyers under a white ledge, the lawn chair with a cap of it, the bay steaming. The strip's first snow.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the shack and dock under an inch of rare snow, the bay steaming in the cold, the flyers' wall with a white ledge on each one.

image.prompt: a shingle bait shack and its dock under a thin rare coastal snow with the bay steaming behind and a row of pinned flyers each capped with snow, no words

panels.name: Snow

panels.composition: Tier 2: the lawn chair with a cap of snow. Empty since 2001.

image.prompt: an old aluminum lawn chair on a dock with a cap of snow on its seat, no words

panels.name: Chair

panels.composition: Tier 3: the dock's planks in snow with one set of boot prints and one set of dog prints going to the end and back. Held.

image.prompt: snow on dock planks with a set of boot prints and a set of small dog prints going to the end and back, no words

panels.name: Prints

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: The strip's first snow. The chair capped.
